cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Sr Robotics Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Oversee the end-to-end design, prototyping and fabricating of commercial-grade robotic systems, from concept to production, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Manage end-to-end manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, focusing on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability.
Prototyping and fabricating advanced linear motion track systems specifically tailored for cobot applications, ensuring seamless integration and optimized performance in various industrial settings.
Conduct thorough compatibility assessments to align the motion track capabilities with cobot specifications, including load capacity, speed, precision, and environmental conditions.
Lead the selection and integration of industrial automation hardware, focusing on the development of robust, scalable, and efficient automation solutions.
Deep understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, EtherCAT, Profinet) and how to implement them for seamless machine-to-machine communication and system interoperability.
Oversee the integration of automation components into existing systems, ensuring compatibility, performance optimization, and adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
Expertise in selecting high-quality industrial and commercial grade hardware components, ensuring they meet the rigorous demands of industrial applications and comply with relevant standards.
Conduct comprehensive testing and validation of hardware systems to ensure they perform reliably under various conditions and meet all operational requirements.
Develop advanced control algorithms for robotic systems, leveraging sensors, actuators, and feedback mechanisms to achieve precise control and intelligent behavior.
Ensure hardware compliance by staying abreast of industry standards and regulations, incorporating them into the design and development processes.
Utilize end-to-end prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, and optionally PCB fabrication and assembly.
Demonstrate proficiency in mechanical design principles, encompassing joint mechanisms, Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience in manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, focusing on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability for commercial-grade robotic systems.
Experience with commercial-grade robotic components, sensors, actuators, and motion systems, as well as familiarity with industry standards and regulations.
Exceptional attention to detail, proactive thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a team to achieve project objectives.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Requirements
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product management, and quality assurance, to align the development process with organizational goals and market needs.
Stay abreast of technological advancements and industry trends to continually enhance system capabilities and introduce innovative solutions.
Foster a culture of safety and continuous improvement, implementing best practices in engineering and manufacturing to achieve excellence in all project deliverables.
Exposure in pre-sales activities, showcasing technical expertise and presenting solutions to potential clients.

cond_0377.responsibilities:
Oversee the end-to-end design, prototyping, and fabrication of commercial-grade robotic systems, from concept to production, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Direct end-to-end manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, with a focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability.
Lead the prototyping and fabrication of advanced linear motion track systems tailored for cobot applications, ensuring seamless integration and optimized performance across various industrial settings.
Execute thorough compatibility assessments to align motion track capabilities with cobot specifications, including load capacity, speed, precision, and environmental conditions.
Drive the selection and integration of industrial automation hardware, focusing on the development of robust, scalable, and efficient automation solutions.
Apply deep understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, EtherCAT, Profinet) to implement seamless machine-to-machine communication and system interoperability.
Own the integration of automation components into existing systems, ensuring compatibility, performance optimization, and adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
Determine and select high-quality industrial and commercial-grade hardware components, ensuring they meet the rigorous demands of industrial applications and comply with relevant standards.
Conduct comprehensive testing and validation of hardware systems to ensure reliable performance under various conditions and full compliance with operational requirements.
Develop advanced control algorithms for robotic systems, leveraging sensors, actuators, and feedback mechanisms to achieve precise control and intelligent behavior.
Ensure hardware compliance by staying current with industry standards and regulations and incorporating them into design and development processes.
Execute end-to-end prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, and optionally PCB fabrication and assembly.
Apply proficiency in mechanical design principles, encompassing joint mechanisms, Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
cond_0377.requirements:
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience in manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, focusing on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability for commercial-grade robotic systems.
Exceptional attention to detail, proactive thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a team to achieve project objectives.
Ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product management, and quality assurance, to align the development process with organizational goals and market needs.
Ability to stay current with technological advancements and industry trends to continually enhance system capabilities and introduce innovative solutions.
Commitment to a culture of safety and continuous improvement, implementing best practices in engineering and manufacturing across all project deliverables.
Experience with commercial-grade robotic components, sensors, actuators, and motion systems, as well as familiarity with industry standards and regulations.
Exposure to pre-sales activities, showcasing technical expertise and presenting solutions to potential clients.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.

cond_0405.intro: We are looking for a Sr Robotics Manufacturing Engineer to join our team, working alongside colleagues to prototype and fabricate commercial-grade robotics. The right candidate has a track record of building and delivering advanced robotic solutions, with strong attention to detail and solid problem-solving skills.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Coordinate end-to-end design, prototyping, and fabrication of commercial-grade robotic systems, from concept to production, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Work with the team to manage manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, with a focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability.
Collaborate on prototyping and fabricating advanced linear motion track systems tailored for cobot applications, ensuring seamless integration and optimized performance in various industrial settings.
Conduct compatibility assessments together with relevant stakeholders to align motion track capabilities with cobot specifications, including load capacity, speed, precision, and environmental conditions.
Coordinate the selection and integration of industrial automation hardware, contributing to the development of robust, scalable, and efficient automation solutions.
Apply understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, EtherCAT, Profinet) to support seamless machine-to-machine communication and system interoperability.
Work alongside the team to integrate automation components into existing systems, ensuring compatibility, performance optimization, and adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
Support the selection of high-quality industrial and commercial grade hardware components, ensuring they meet the demands of industrial applications and comply with relevant standards.
Coordinate comprehensive testing and validation of hardware systems to ensure reliable performance under various conditions and alignment with operational requirements.
Contribute to the development of control algorithms for robotic systems, working with sensors, actuators, and feedback mechanisms to achieve precise control and intelligent behavior.
Help ensure hardware compliance by staying current with industry standards and regulations, incorporating them into design and development processes.
Utilize end-to-end prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, and optionally PCB fabrication and assembly.
Apply mechanical design principles, encompassing joint mechanisms, Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience in manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, for commercial-grade robotic systems.
Experience with commercial-grade robotic components, sensors, actuators, and motion systems, as well as familiarity with industry standards and regulations.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to work closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product management, and quality assurance, to align development with organizational goals and market needs.
Familiarity with technological advancements and industry trends to enhance system capabilities and introduce new solutions.
Commitment to safety and continuous improvement, implementing best practices in engineering and manufacturing.
Exposure to pre-sales activities, including presenting technical solutions to potential clients.

cond_0592.responsibilities:
Oversee the end-to-end design, prototyping, and fabrication of commercial-grade robotic systems, from concept to production, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Manage end-to-end manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, with a focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability.
Prototype and fabricate advanced linear motion track systems tailored for cobot applications, ensuring integration and optimized performance in various industrial settings.
Conduct compatibility assessments to align motion track capabilities with cobot specifications, including load capacity, speed, precision, and environmental conditions.
Lead the selection and integration of industrial automation hardware, focusing on the development of robust, scalable, and efficient automation solutions.
Apply understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, EtherCAT, Profinet) to implement machine-to-machine communication and system interoperability.
Oversee the integration of automation components into existing systems, ensuring compatibility, performance optimization, and adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
Select high-quality industrial and commercial-grade hardware components, ensuring they meet the demands of industrial applications and comply with relevant standards.
Conduct testing and validation of hardware systems to confirm reliable performance under various conditions and against operational requirements.
Develop control algorithms for robotic systems, using sensors, actuators, and feedback mechanisms to achieve precise control and reliable behavior.
Track industry standards and regulations and incorporate them into design and development processes to maintain hardware compliance.
Use end-to-end prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, and optionally PCB fabrication and assembly.
Apply mechanical design principles, including joint mechanisms, Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
cond_0592.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience in manufacturing and fabrication processes, from material selection to final assembly, with a focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability for commercial-grade robotic systems.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to deliver project objectives.
Able to coordinate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product management, and quality assurance, to align development with project goals and requirements.
Keeps up with technological developments and industry trends to support ongoing improvements to system capabilities.
Applies best practices in engineering and manufacturing, with a focus on safety and continuous improvement across project deliverables.
Experience with commercial-grade robotic components, sensors, actuators, and motion systems, along with familiarity with industry standards and regulations.
Some exposure to pre-sales activities, including presenting technical solutions to potential clients.
Strong written communication skills and the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
